mapper.sql: id, user_id, gender, major, grade, base_level, weekly_study_minutes, weak_points_json, profile_json, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_profile (user_id, gender, major, grade, base_level, weekly_study_minutes, weak_points_json, profile_json, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{gender}, #{major}, #{grade}, #{baseLevel}, #{weeklyStudyMinutes}, #{weakPointsJson, typeHandler=com.group4.kaoyan.common.mybatis.JsonTypeHandler}, #{profileJson, typeHandler=com.group4.kaoyan.common.mybatis.JsonTypeHandler}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_profile SET gender = #{gender}, major = #{major}, grade = #{grade}, base_level = #{baseLevel}, weekly_study_minutes = #{weeklyStudyMinutes}, weak_points_json = #{weakPointsJson, typeHandler=com.group4.kaoyan.common.mybatis.JsonTypeHandler}, profile_json = #{profileJson, typeHandler=com.group4.kaoyan.common.mybatis.JsonTypeHandler}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
